steps.why: Attach the fixture devices to the HTTP-created zone and configure a second hardware generation without calling ChirpStack provisioning.
Review fixture data for the paired parity probe.
steps.sql: UPDATE valve_settings SET last_clock_sync_queued_at=strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'); INSERT INTO valve_settings(device_eui,last_clock_sync_queued_at) SELECT deveui,strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now') FROM devices WHERE type_id='STREGA_VALVE' AND deveui NOT IN (SELECT device_eui FROM valve_settings)
